scope: Primary research, systematic reviews, position stands, and official competition standards used to define conservative validation guardrails. These sources support programming principles, not guaranteed outcomes.

sources.title: Effects of tapering on performance in endurance athletes: systematic review and meta-analysis
sources.use: Endurance taper should reduce volume while retaining event-specific intensity and frequency.

sources.title: Effects of tapering on performance: a meta-analysis
sources.use: Supports a progressive pre-event volume reduction rather than eliminating intensity.

sources.title: Training theory and taper: validation in triathlon athletes
sources.use: Supports a structured multisport taper and retained discipline-specific work.

sources.title: Acute physiological responses and performance determinants in HYROX
sources.use: Supports running endurance, station repeatability, and controlled competition simulations.

sources.title: High Intensity Functional Training in Hybrid Competitions: scoping review
sources.use: Supports integrated aerobic, strength, power, and repeated-effort preparation.

sources.title: Predictors of CrossFit performance: systematic review
sources.use: Supports retention of strength, technical skill, and broad competition-specific capacity.

sources.title: Physical demands and physiological responses to CrossFit: scoping review
sources.use: Supports competition-specific practice and recovery spacing after demanding mixed-modal work.

sources.title: HIIT in Olympic combat-sport athletes: systematic review
sources.use: Supports intermittent round-capacity work as conditioning support to technical-tactical training.

sources.title: Tapering and peaking maximal strength for powerlifting performance
sources.use: Supports competition-lift specificity, fatigue reduction, and retained heavy-skill exposure.

sources.title: Strength and conditioning practices of strongman competitors
sources.use: Supports maximal strength, power, carries, loading, grip, and direct implement practice.

sources.title: Biomechanics and applications of strongman exercises: systematic review
sources.use: Supports event-pattern practice for carries, pulls, loading, and awkward-object tasks.

sources.title: Effects of physical training on load carriage performance: systematic review
sources.use: Supports combined aerobic, strength, and progressive loaded-movement preparation.

sources.title: Physiology and biomechanics of load carriage performance
sources.use: Supports controlled load-speed progression and impact management.

sources.title: Physiological demands of extreme obstacle-course racing
sources.use: Supports combined endurance, grip, obstacle, and terrain-specific preparation while acknowledging limited evidence.

sources.title: Natural bodybuilding contest preparation: resistance and cardiovascular training
sources.use: Supports continued resistance training, recoverable cardio, frequency, and fatigue control during contest preparation.

sources.title: Evidence-based natural bodybuilding contest preparation
sources.use: Supports conservative contest-preparation pacing and muscle-retention safeguards.

sources.title: ACSM progression models in resistance training for healthy adults
sources.use: Supports general progressive resistance training in custom-event fallback programming.
